Connect a self-hosted Forgejo, Gitea, or GitLab instance to mirror pull requests onto issues. Each connection uses an access token; agents push branches and open PRs using the runtime's own Git credentials.

Finish setup in your provider

Add a webhook on your repository or organisation with the URL and secret below. Forgejo/Gitea: choose the Gitea format and the Pull Request (and Commit Status) events. GitLab: paste the secret as the token and enable Merge request and Pipeline events.
